product.claim_boundary: The generic declarative profile, deterministic read-only planner, strict URDF inspection, executable eleven-file Genesis/LeRobot/ACT/ROCm port-bundle compilation, one generated synthetic bimanual 7+7 no-command Genesis gs.amdgpu runtime, and a same-device ACT-shaped BF16/FP16 microbenchmark are verified. A second real robot runtime port, controlled motion, ACT task accuracy, general AMD performance advantage, clean-room reproduction, final video, public repository, submission, Pull Request, and competition acceptance remain unproven.
